title_en: Is a day on Venus longer than its year? #shorts
desc_en:
Venus takes about 243 Earth days to spin once on its axis, but only 225 Earth days to go around the Sun. So one Venus day is longer than one Venus year.
Venus also spins backward, so the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east.
